content: {"paper_id":"lab-36466e9ba385","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"nonnegative-matrix-factorization","exact_quote":"As a variant of nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), symmetric NMF (SNMF) has shown to be effective for capturing the cluster structure embedded in the graph representation.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以对称非负矩阵分解（SNMF）作为NMF变体，是论文方法核心。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"PCPSNMF is capable of learning the similarity and assignment matrices adaptively and simultaneously","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"方法自适应学习样本相似度矩阵，即学习/修正样本间亲和关系，符合图结构学习。"},{"keyword_id":"pairwise-constraint-propagation","exact_quote":"we propose a novel SNMF-based semisupervised clustering method, namely, pairwise constraint propagation-induced SNMF (PCPSNMF).","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要方法名直接表明由成对约束传播诱导，属扩展成对监督关系的成对约束传播。"},{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"we propose a novel SNMF-based semisupervised clustering method","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确称为半监督聚类，并用少量成对约束监督信息引导学习，符合有限监督与未标注样本结合的设定。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","reason_zh":"摘要只提对称非负矩阵分解，未明确将低秩约束或低秩近似作为独立机制。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"存在少量成对约束监督信息，但摘要明确为半监督聚类，是否作为独立弱监督研究条件不明确。"}],"input_issues":[]}
